purpose: S12 moves the join-request protocol (D8) onto the library inbox: the requester sends kind 21059 with extensions.sendInboxRumor (retryable/failed = the existing send-failure state, no retry timer); the admin's registerInboxHandler(21059) handler takes the requester only from the seal-bound rumor.pubkey, drops blocked senders first, dedupes by rumor.id, applies the unchanged nonce/mute/expiry/dedup gates and persists; approval runs on the client job queue through the key-package invite (already-member is a no-op success); auto-accept (invitations/autoAccept.ts) correlates a pending invitation with an unexpired outbound request exactly once. The DM listener gains a pure dispatcher that skips the library-inbox kinds silently and routes pairing-ack.

public_api.name: createJoinRequestInboxHandler
public_api.signature: (deps: { denyLayer: Pick<DenyLayer,'isBlocked'>; inviteLinks: {get}; memberPubkeys: (groupId)=>readonly string[]; requests: {load,save}; seen: {has,add}; now: ()=>number; onReceived: (r: PendingJoinRequest)=>void; onError? }) => InboxRumorHandler
public_api.description: joinRequestHandler.ts. Every port validated at construction. Order: wrong kind/malformed sender/missing id, deny layer (before any lookup or write), seen rumor id, parse, nonce/mute/expiry, member roster snapshot, same requester+group duplicate, save, seen.add, bell. A storage failure is reported and rethrown (the library defers and redelivers). No client call. joinRequestStorePorts = the idb-backed production ports.

public_api.name: createJoinRequestSender
public_api.signature: (deps: { inbox: {sendInboxRumor}; ownPubkey: string; now: ()=>number; saveOutbound: (r: OutboundJoinRequestRecord)=>Promise<void>; onError? }) => { send(params: {adminPubkeyHex, nonce, groupName, requesterName?}): Promise<void> }
public_api.description: joinRequestSender.ts. One sendInboxRumor of a canonical-id rumor (kind 21059, tags [['p',admin]], content {type,nonce,name,requesterName}). delivered: the outbound record is written (a write failure is reported, never fails the send); retryable/failed/rejected: JoinRequestSendError (outcome, reason, cause), no record, no timer. JoinRequestSendError is the existing send-failure state of the UI catch blocks.

public_api.name: createJoinRequestApproval
public_api.signature: (deps: { inviter: Pick<KeyPackageInviter,'inviteByPubkey'>; getGroup: (groupId)=>Promise<InviteGroup|undefined>; enqueue: ClientJobQueue['enqueue']-like; consumeRequest: (r)=>Promise<void>; onApproved: (r, kind)=>void|Promise<void>; onError? }) => { approve(request): Promise<ApprovalResult> }
public_api.description: joinRequestApproval.ts (the KeyPackageInvite consumer). getGroup and inviteByPubkey run only inside a handle.enqueue job. invited -> consume + onApproved('invited'); {error:'already-member'} -> consume + onApproved('already-member'), plain success, no group.invite; no usable key package / thrown error -> request stays pending. Same request in flight shares one run; a non-accepting queue settles queue-unavailable.

public_api.name: createAutoAccept
public_api.signature: (deps: { view: Pick<PendingInvitationView,'refresh'|'scheduleRefresh'>; actions: Pick<InvitationActions,'accept'>; enqueue; outbound: {loadUnexpiredForAdmin, consume}; groupNameOf: (inv)=>string|undefined; onError? }) => { onInboxDisposition(d), evaluate(), idle(), dispose() }
public_api.description: invitations/autoAccept.ts. onInboxDisposition is a frame-safe listener (pending only; enqueue last, collapsing). The job refreshes the view (shown set only: a blocked sponsor is never auto-accepted), correlates on sponsorAccount === admin and the sanitised group name (known name: exactly one record of that name; unknown name: exactly one record), accepts through actions.accept at most once per invitation id, consumes the record after a successful accept, and ends with view.scheduleRefresh().

public_api.name: dispatchDmGiftWrap / DM_PLANE_SKIPPED_KINDS
public_api.description: directMessages.ts. Opens the wrap with the strict unwrapAndOpen, skips 444/library control kinds (RESERVED_KINDS)/21059/21064 silently, routes 21060 to the injected pairing handler with the wrap, returns every other rumor to the listener.

public_api.name: hasSeenJoinRequestRumor / markJoinRequestRumorSeen / SEEN_JOIN_REQUEST_CAP
public_api.description: joinRequestStorage.ts. Durable bounded rumor-id memory (own idb store few-join-request-seen), oldest evicted by stored time, the just-written id never evicted, cleared by clearAllPendingJoinRequests.

public_api.name: useOutboundJoinRequests (src/hooks)
public_api.description: Moved out of outboundJoinRequests.ts (React import removed, LEGACY_REACT_IMPORTERS exemption deleted); the module now exports getLoadedSnapshot/getLoadedServerSnapshot for the hook.

owned_data: few-join-requests (pending requests, key rumor id), few-join-request-seen (new, rumor id -> time, cap 512), few-invite-links, few-outbound-join-requests (access only through their storage modules)
dependencies_allowed: invitations/ (index: DenyLayer, KeyPackageInviter, InviteGroup types; autoAccept lives in invitations/ and imports only invitations siblings)
inviteLinkStorage.ts, joinRequestStorage.ts, outboundJoinRequests.ts (idb-keyval stores of this domain)
client/ (types only: ClientJobQueue shape via the injected enqueue)

any account-scope client call from the inbox handler or the client listener frame (follow-ups only via handle.enqueue, enqueue last)
publishing the join request or any profile data outside a gift wrap (privacy invariant)
